audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN 6/10 with Gwen winning Level 1, against a 43.28% win rate over 305 games and prose that says 'Singed is the worst kind of tank for me' and 'This is where Singed buries me'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Singed for six of seven rows with only Level 6 to Gwen.
audit.corrected: HARD 8/10, chart realigned to the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text; the one Gwen window was not tied to anything concrete.
audit.why: Gwen's only spike is Level 6 (Needlework slow plus Skip 'n Slash attack speed); Singed's are Mega Adhesive coming online and his Rylai's/Liandry's timing, which lands before Riftmaker.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent from both layers.
audit.why: Riot on Mega Adhesive: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it' — grounding denies Skip 'n Slash outright, and Gwen's own kit file flags her dash as 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny'. Riot on Fling: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted' — the root is conditional on the goo, so the vial is the tell, not the flip. Riot on Insanity Potion: it makes 'his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds', which cuts the A Thousand Cuts healing Gwen's whole extended-trade plan rests on.
audit.corrected: Grounding, the conditional root, and the ultimate's anti-heal all written into the phase whys, cooldown block, trading block, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Fling' with no number, and Fling is the wrong ability to track.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13s and is what disables your dash; Fling is only 8-10s and is harmless without the goo underneath it.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive is now the tracked cooldown.

audit.why: Anti-heal was already called for, and it is right: he is a drain tank.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Singed contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Singed proxies and walks at you on Noxious Slipstream speed. Fling is 125 range — stay off him, and never last-hit standing in Poison Trail.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Singed's Fling is down.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds. Land in it and Skip 'n Slash simply will not cast — that is the whole lane.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit, but Mega Adhesive grounds your dash and Fling roots you if he lands you in the goo. Watch the vial, not the man.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Fling's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Fling is 8-10s and Mega Adhesive 13-17s. Step up only when the goo is on cooldown, or the flip becomes a root you cannot dash out of.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Singed's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your one window: Needlework slows him and Skip 'n Slash's attack speed sticks. But Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Fling's cooldown.
edits.after: His Rylai's and Liandry's land before Riftmaker, and the kite out-paces your dash.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Singed carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he simply never commits — an uncatchable drain tank is the one bar your %-max-HP grind cannot finish. Group instead.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Mist it, then Snip. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Mega Adhesive (13-17s): it GROUNDS — inside it Skip 'n Slash will not cast at all. That is the matchup. - Fling (8-10s): roots you only if he lands you in the goo. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Singed with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Singed wastes Fling — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Singed with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Mega Adhesive is on cooldown — nothing grounds you, so commit. Bad trade: chasing through Poison Trail under Insanity Potion, where Grievous Wounds cuts every point of A Thousand Cuts healing.

edits.before: That is Singed's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is stationary and 18-22s — it cannot follow a man who simply walks away from the zone.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Mist it, then Snip. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds your dash; Fling roots if you land in it; Insanity Potion adds anti-heal.

edits.before: Don’t chase through poison — Snip his HP and W his fling combo. Gwen wins by trading around Singed's Fling and cashing the pattern: w-mist his fling and Snip his HP.
edits.after: Don't chase through poison — Mega Adhesive grounds your dash and Insanity Potion anti-heals your passive. Gwen only wins the level-6 window, and only with the goo down.

notes: Rated EVEN with a 43.28% win rate; corrected to HARD. Mega Adhesive's grounding is the single most important fact in this matchup and appeared nowhere — Gwen's kit file explicitly notes her dash is deniable by grounding. Insanity Potion applying Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail was also missing and directly counters her passive sustain plan.
